name: building-saas
description: Build a SaaS company from idea to scale — product development, architecture decisions, pricing, hiring sequence, fundraising stages, and operational infrastructure. Use when starting a SaaS, scaling from $0 to $10M ARR, making build-vs-buy decisions, or designing the technical and operational foundation of a software business. Triggers on: "build a SaaS", "start a SaaS", "SaaS architecture", "SaaS startup", "build software business", "SaaS from scratch", "tech stack for SaaS", or any request about building a software company.
